final: WITH line AS (SELECT link_to_event, spent*1.0/amount AS r FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL), ev AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, AVG(r) AS ratio FROM line GROUP BY link_to_event), o AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS a FROM ev) SELECT event_id, ratio, ratio/(SELECT a FROM o) AS relative FROM ev ORDER BY relative IS NULL, relative DESC LIMIT 10
